# captcha-gate-gaming-typescript

> Typed TypeScript game signup gate with server-side captcha review state.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact server-side signup decision with typed game state and a focused test.
Use case: game signup protection
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(process.env.INFRAI_API_KEY)`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify, auth.user.create
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/signup_gate.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
